The condition can also be triggered by other factors such as viral infections and graft-versus-host disease. ### Pathophysiology In HSOC, the sinusoidal endothelial cells of the liver become damaged. As a result, there is increased pressure in hepatic veins leading to congestion and hepatomegaly. texts.full_text: se docs are for Singularity Version 2.5.1. For older versions, see our archive Why do we need SCI-F? The Scientific Filesystem (SCIF) provides modularity of containers, and it makes it easy for the creator to give the container implied metadata about software. For example, installing a set of libraries, defining environment variables, or adding labels that belong to app foo makes a strong assertion that those dependencies belong to foo. When I run foo, I can be confident that the container is running in this context, meaning with foo's custom environment, and with foo’s libraries and executables on the path. This is drastically different from serving many executables in a single container, because there is no way to know which are associated with which executable. With SCIF, the container is organized in a way that the different executables and their associated dependencies are logically grouped, which makes the container more organized, maintainable, and user-friendly. This is particularly beneficial in the scientific and research community, where a container might need to include a variety of different tools and dependencies, and where the user might need to switch between different tools and their associated environments. There have been times in my life where I genuinely didn’t have the bandwidth to explore a new friendship and yet if I or we were invited to a dinner or an event we were obligated to say yes. Otherwise, it would be rude. Because making up excuses or passively avoiding follow-through or faking enjoyment for the sake of avoiding hurt feelings was far less rude.
